summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the switch and its accessible name. Required: an outside label cannot name a control inside the component (SB-0009).

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text next to the switch already names the setting.

description.note: Help text under the label, read as the switch's description.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission (customError).

size.note: Track and thumb size only: default 32x20 track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 track with a 12px thumb. Label text is the same in both.

name.note: Form field name. Without it nothing is submitted.

value.note: Submitted under name while the switch is on; nothing is submitted while it is off.

checked.note: On or off. Not reflected: the attribute is the default that form reset restores.

required.note: Must be on for the form to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds a hidden-from-AT asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Cannot be focused or toggled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor has the same effect without changing this prop.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Two columns: the track in the first, label, description and error stacked in the second.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.notes: Pill-shaped track; filled with the off or on color. Holds the native control and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native checkbox input with role switch, covering the whole track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob at the inline start when off and the inline end when on; position is the non-color cue for the state.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Names the switch; clicking it toggles the switch.

anatomy.name: required-indicator
anatomy.notes: Asterisk, hidden from assistive technology (required is exposed natively).

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; its text appears when the field is invalid.

input.note: Each user toggle. Native and composed.

change.note: Each user toggle, after checked and the form value are updated. Re-dispatched from the host because the native change event does not leave the component. Not fired when checked is set by code or by form reset.

hover.trigger: pointer over an enabled switch or its label

focus-visible.note: Solid 3px ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with the on color and the thumb moves to the inline end.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled, or inside a disabled fieldset

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native label element tied to the inner input in the same scope.

formAssociation.note: Form-associated custom element: submits value under name only while on; form reset restores the default checked state (the checked attribute); form state restore re-applies the saved checked state; a disabled fieldset ancestor disables it without touching the disabled attribute and it is not submitted; validity is mirrored from the inner input (required and off -> valueMissing), error adds customError; reportValidity focuses the switch; an outside <label for> activates it.

accessibility.targetSize: Default track 32x20 and sm 24x16; the label next to it is part of the clickable row, and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception for sm.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus only; 3px solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the owning form, like a native checkbox (implicit submission, SB-0009); does not toggle

aria: role=switch on the native input; aria-checked follows the native checked state (true/false, never mixed)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
disabled: native disabled, so the switch leaves the tab order
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: state change is announced by the screen reader from the native switch role (on/off)
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off, such as enabling notifications
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting, not the action

useCases.when: The setting needs its effect or consequence explained
A dense list of settings, such as table rows or a compact settings panel
The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required, with a label that states what is being turned on

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for choosing several items from a list or agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that is on or off, not as a selection or an agreement

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing one option from two or more that are not on/off (for example light or dark)
antiPatterns.why: Off does not name the other option

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that changes with the state, or reads as an action ("Turn on")
antiPatterns.why: The role already announces on or off; a changing label contradicts it
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting ("Notifications")

antiPatterns.pattern: A parent switch that summarizes several child settings
antiPatterns.why: A switch has no partial state, so it cannot show that only some children are on

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: the visual reference composes Field and Label around Switch; an outside label cannot name a control inside the component, so they are built in
the visual reference uses an 18.4px track height; the semantic token rounds it to the 4px grid

drift.contract: off thumb color.background, on thumb color.primary-foreground in every mode
drift.realization: the visual reference switches the off thumb to the foreground color in dark mode; one mapping per state keeps the tokens mode-free and the pair is checked for contrast in every mode
the visual reference uses ring/50, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

drift.contract: track border in destructive and a visible error message
drift.realization: the visual reference only tints the ring on aria-invalid and has no message
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern on a native checkbox input with role switch; look and sizes from the visual reference, with the deviations listed as drift.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (allowed by the APG) or submit the form?
openQuestions.recommendation: Submit the form, like a native checkbox and sb-checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the owning form (SB-0009) and does not toggle; Space toggles. Same keys as Checkbox, so every form control behaves alike (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: What does the switch submit while off?
openQuestions.answer: value (default "on") under name while on; no entry while off. Servers already read a missing checkbox as off; submitting "off" would break that (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The checked attribute is the default form reset restores (native defaultChecked); the property is the live state (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and under which names?
openQuestions.recommendation: default and sm, the visual reference's names (aliased to medium and small in the API vocabulary).
openQuestions.answer: size = default | sm; only the track and thumb change, from the existing size.switch.* semantic tokens (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and does the switch show on/off text or icons inside the track?
openQuestions.recommendation: Label required with hide-label; no text or icons in the track.
openQuestions.answer: Label is required (hide-label keeps it as the name). No in-track text: thumb position is the non-color cue and the role announces the state (SB-0101).

openQuestions.question: Manual screen-reader pass (VoiceOver + Safari, NVDA + Firefox) of name, role, state and description once implemented.
openQuestions.recommendation: Run it before the component moves to beta.
